properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Idea D3 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, 2026-09-29.

WHAT HAPPENED. The owner agent refused to ratify "18 components" from a summary ("I won't ratify a parts list I haven't seen"). When it was shown the list, it amended one part in a way the summary had hidden. It judged everything from relayed text chosen by the party whose work it was judging. Measured cause: fact:root-cause-an-owner-outside-the-chat-cannot-read-what-it-is-asked-to-approve-2026-09-29.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS, SO THIS IS NOT RE-OPENED:
- req:the-agent-renders-the-design-for-the-reader-who-needs-it (accepted): the agent renders a view for a reader it is TALKING to.
- req:the-loop-says-what-is-owed-to-a-person (proposed): loop_status(contributor_id) lists assigned decisions by id.
The open part is a reader who is NOT in the agent's conversation, and content rather than ids.

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) NOTHING NEW. An owner gets their own agent session and runs where-am-i themselves.
(b) A SKILL, where-am-i scoped to a named person: it renders loop_status(contributor_id) in the reader's words, with each item's options and recommendation.
(c) A SERVED READ (a tool) returning the digest as data, so a host (flo2's browser, a hub) can render it for a person with no agent at all.
(d) (c) plus the per-item evidence of the companion question-batch idea.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS KEPT.
· A digest is a summary, and a summary is what the owner distrusted. It must link to the full node, not replace it.
· Without an addressee on Questions and ratifications (D2, and the structure-ratification finding), the digest has little to list. It depends on them.
· flo2's own browser ideas (dec:idea-your-flo2-account-page-shows-your-designs, dec:idea-ruling-on-a-decision-from-the-browser, in flo2's design) may be the better home for the human half.

SIZE: (a) free. (b) a skill over existing reads. (c) a new read tool, small. (d) inherits D2's size.
properties.name: OPEN — should reflow2 serve one addressed read, "what you are being asked to approve", for a named person: each pending decision, question and ratification with its options, the recommendation, and what it rests on, in plain language, so a second party can judge without driving the tools?
properties.rationale: The exercise showed the second party pays for itself only when it can see the thing it judges. This is the read half of that; the record half is D2.
